presets.name: Grand Hall
presets.description: Full concert grand simulation. Rich, lush resonance with long reverb. The flagship sound — evocative of a 9-foot Steinway in a recital hall.

presets.name: Chamber Piano
presets.description: Intimate, close-miked feel. Less reverb, tighter strings — the sound of a piano in a carpeted practice room three feet away.

presets.name: Upright Piano
presets.description: Dark, slightly honky character. Short decay, lower brightness — an old upright in a rehearsal space with soft hammers.

presets.name: String Halo
presets.description: Very subtle atmospheric shimmer. The resonance is barely there — a ghost behind your playing. Beautiful for ballads and fingerpicking.

presets.name: Infinite Shimmer
presets.description: Play a note, engage SW_SUSTAIN (left footswitch), then lift your hands. A resonant pad blooms and sustains indefinitely. Engage SW_KILL to silence and rebuild.
presets.performance_note: Engage SW_SUSTAIN (left stomp) immediately after the note is struck for best effect.
